_comment: Grade 8 Science diagrams, one per item of the figure list (65 of 65; the duplicate low-resolution screenshot of 1.4 was dropped). Titles were cropped off the original screenshots so they do not give answers away, and the screenshots were enlarged 1.5x; letters A, B, C... were added to blank answer boxes (boxes already numbered or lettered in the source were left alone). Chapter names are placeholders taken from the figure numbering (1.x = chapter 1) and must be renamed to the exact grade 8 textbook chapter titles before seeding. Entries with a 'note' need a quick check.

figures.subject: Science
figures.caption: A flowchart of seven boxes joined by down arrows: Observe, a blank step, Form a hypothesis, a blank step, Test / Experiment, a blank step, Draw conclusion
labels: B: Make a prediction / plan the experiment
C: Record and analyse the results
figures.note: Letters A-C were added to the three blank steps. The missing steps are my reading of the usual scientific method; check them against your textbook's flowchart.
